test_SO3_exp_map: test the SO3 exponential map by converting tangent vectors to rotation matrices with various angle factors
test_SO3_log_map: test the SO3 logarithm map by verifying exp then log returns the original tangent vector
test_SO3_inverse: test the SO3 inverse operation on randomly generated rotation groups across batch sizes and dtypes
test_SO3_quaternion: test SO3 to quaternion conversion and verify round-trip accuracy via matrix reconstruction
test_SO3_rotate_unrotate: test SO3 rotate and unrotate operations on 3D points and verify their computed jacobians
